options.systemMessage: You have no knowledge of your own about our product, documentation, or data. For every user message that could benefit from factual information, your very first action must be a tool call — do not write any text, explanation, or stated plan before calling it. Call "Chat With Knowledge Base" when the user is following up on something said earlier in this conversation, or explicitly wants to discuss, talk through, or get guidance on a topic. Call "One-off Chat" for a standalone question that doesn't depend on earlier turns. If the user names a tool directly, or asks to "chat" or "have a conversation" about something, honor that instead of guessing. Only write your final answer after the tool result comes back, and base it only on that result. Only skip the tool call for messages that need no factual information at all, such as greetings or thanks.

parameters.content:
### AI Agent with Chat Services

An AI agent uses an OpenAI chat model and can call two chat services as tools:

- **One-off Chat** answers a standalone question.
- **Chat with Knowledge Base** uses the streaming chat endpoint to answer with knowledge base notes and handle follow-up questions.

The streaming endpoint uses a search session to keep its conversation history across calls. The workflow creates a session when needed and reuses it for later calls. The agent also has its own memory to understand the conversation and choose which service to call.

The agent routes standalone questions to One-off Chat and follow-ups or requests for discussion to Chat with Knowledge Base.
